Welcome to Andah/Janus world-building project, a project to create an in-depth fictional world, from economics, culture, linguistics and history. The project began in late 2024, while the wiki officially launched in June 2025. Currently, there are over 130 articles, but there's an ambitious plan to expand this to over 1,000.

If this is your first visit, I hope you’ll follow the project!
----Andah is a fantasy/fictional world set in the year 1765 (2010s~ technology level for comparison). Some of the achievements so far include; A complete history of the planet every year, Wikipedia pages for each of the 172 nations, economic data for every nation, oil reserves, and so much more. 

Humans arrived on andah 200,000 Years ago, the exact location is still up for debate, but most agree it's most likely to be in southern acrola. Humans differ alot than humans on earth, since they have had enough time to evolve to the slightly different ecological zones of the planet. Andah, or what Earth calls it, Janus, named after the respective greek god, is located on the directly opposite side of the sun to earth, it radiate at the same distance from the sun as earth, scientist still don't understand how humans arrived on andah. It is confirmed that humans did not evolve on andah as they have no connection to the organisms of the planet; some say it was extraterrestrials, possibly a higher power. 

Politics-wise, the world is split into 5 main spheres of influence, the first is led by the Atirhran power of Raledira and its allies, the Pelugrotoa leads the second in Mahea, Areoix Lie leads the third in Northern Acrona, Dahe leads the fourth in Massir, and the Quian Union leads the fifth in western Quia.
